gates.summary: Retrieval Fabric is additive and preserves Hybrid SOT, Mirai 2.1 contracts, the 2.2 source adapter surface, 2.3 graph operations and the mirai-graph wrapper.
Authorization-bound indexing, evidence answers, stale and conflict handling, explicit degraded mode and bounded federation pass the focused suite.
Independent Python checker revision 298472cf25917f5f69183d8bcfb3bb4712e8c796 passes locally and on Linux, macOS and Windows against the frozen Mirai retrieval candidate.
The owner-authorized isolated AI-assisted review passed the production-read scope with no unresolved critical or high finding; it does not authorize production-write.
A frozen 121-query English/Russian corpus records lexical, semantic, graph, hybrid and Mirai planner metrics with complete evidence and explicit limitations.
Four controlled public-safe domain slices pass independent artifact reconstruction with zero unauthorized hits and no production effects.

Revision 1231d691059ca02d128ec8bbfcf9b1854772f15b passed the complete Mirai Linux/macOS/Windows CI matrix and CodeQL; independent checker revision 298472cf25917f5f69183d8bcfb3bb4712e8c796 passed its cross-platform matrix.
Primary, compatibility, source-adapter and embedding package metadata is aligned at 2.4.0 and the stable release notes are complete.
Release engineering evidence is explicitly separated from external scientific validation and broad effectiveness claims.

next_safe_action: Run the publication action gate, publish the verified release commit, then create tag and GitHub Release v2.4.0 and publish the aligned npm packages.
claim_boundary: This record authorizes release packaging, not deployment-specific production-write, unrestricted remote federation, automatic canonical updates or universal retrieval-quality claims.
